title: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(5)
desc: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(5)

paragraphs.en: In the early days, said Littleton, there was friction with the local community.
paragraphs.zh: 利特尔顿说，在早期，保护区和当地社区之间存在摩擦。

paragraphs.en: He found the war-hardened Mozambicans aloof and unwelcoming.
paragraphs.zh: 他发现这些历经战火的莫桑比克人态度冷淡、并不欢迎外来者。

paragraphs.en: Plenty of outsiders had passed through here over the years - slave traders, colonists, criminals - few with good intentions.
paragraphs.zh: 多年以来，许许多多外人来过这里——奴隶贩子、殖民者、不法之徒——心怀善意者寥寥无几。

paragraphs.en: The locals, subsistence farmers of the Yao and Makua ethnic groups, had no particular love of wildlife either.
paragraphs.zh: 当地居民是尧族和马库阿族靠种地勉强糊口的农民，他们本身对野生动物也并无好感。

paragraphs.en: They might tend a vegetable patch for months only for a herd of elephants to scoff the lot a week before harvest.
paragraphs.zh: 他们辛辛苦苦照料一片菜地好几个月，却可能在收获前一周被一群大象洗劫一空。

paragraphs.en: Hippos, crocodiles, lions, wild dogs were constant dangers to workers cutting their modest plots from the forest.
paragraphs.zh: 河马、鳄鱼、狮子、野狗一直威胁着那些在林中开垦小块耕地劳作的人们。

paragraphs.en: At first, Littleton said, he was offended by their ambivalence towards, even active destruction of, the environment he prized.
paragraphs.zh: 利特尔顿坦言，起初，当地人对他所珍视的这片荒野漠不关心，甚至主动破坏环境，这令他感到不快。

paragraphs.en: Coming across a new clearing in the forest, roughly chopped with a hand axe, stumps still smoking, or the lifeless body of an impala garotted by a homemade snare, he couldn't help but think he was saving Mozambique from the Mozambicans.
paragraphs.zh: 当他在林中看到一处刚开辟出来的空地，斧头劈砍的痕迹清晰可见，树桩还冒着余烟；或是发现一只被自制套索勒死的黑斑羚尸体，他不由得生出一种念头：他要从莫桑比克人手中拯救莫桑比克。

paragraphs.en: This was, he sees now, a paternalist mode of thought.
paragraphs.zh: 如今他意识到，这是一种家长式的思维。

paragraphs.en: The intervening decades have been ones of adaptation, negotiation, a constant search for compromise.
paragraphs.zh: 之后的数十年，双方不断磨合、协商，一直在寻找折中方案。

paragraphs.en: This year, the community's share of the takings of trophy hunting came to 2,000 meticals, or $35 a person, handed over in cash.
paragraphs.zh: 今年，社区从战利品狩猎收益中分得的款项达到每人2000梅蒂卡尔，折合35美元，以现金形式发放。

paragraphs.en: Not much on the face of it, but a welcome gift in a region where the average annual income is about $250.
paragraphs.zh: 表面看来数额不多，但在人均年收入仅约250美元的地区，这笔钱已是一份可喜的收入。

paragraphs.en: Add in $400,000 in development funding, plus job opportunities - 60 anti-poaching scouts, managers and hospitality staff - and the conservancy, a private body, accounts for two-thirds of the local economy.
paragraphs.zh: 再加上40万美元的发展资金以及就业岗位——60名反偷猎巡查员、管理人员和服务人员——这家私营保护区创造的经济产值占到了当地经济总量的三分之二。

paragraphs.en: The following day, I flew with Littleton to the Luwire Conservancy headquarters, 30 miles to the east, or 20 minutes by light aircraft.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天，我和利特尔顿一同搭乘轻型飞机飞往位于东边30英里处的卢威尔保护区总部，航程大约20分钟。

paragraphs.en: In a low, two-room building, Yasalde Massingue, a young Mozambican biologist with a pleasantly eccentric demeanour, was coordinating the conservancy's anti-poaching units by way of real-time tracking data displayed on a bank of screens.
paragraphs.zh: 在一栋低矮的双间房屋内，年轻的莫桑比克生物学家亚萨尔德·马辛盖性格风趣，正靠着一排屏幕上的实时追踪数据调度保护区各个反偷猎小队。

paragraphs.en: These are the rangers, he said, waving to a set of looping tracks starring outwards from camps scattered across the block.
paragraphs.zh: 他一边指着从遍布保护区各处营地向外延伸出的一条条循环轨迹，一边说道，这些就是护林员的行进路线。

paragraphs.en: And these, he said, toggling between displays, are elephants and lions wearing GPS trackers.
paragraphs.zh: 他切换着屏幕界面继续说，而这些，是佩戴了全球定位追踪器的大象和狮子。

paragraphs.en: He keeps an eye on them, checks they don't suddenly stop moving.
paragraphs.zh: 他时刻监控着它们，查看它们有没有突然停止移动。

paragraphs.en: These – he ticked a box and brought up a new set of coloured dots – are vultures.
paragraphs.zh: 他勾选了一个选项，调出一组新的彩色点位标记，说道：这些是秃鹫。

paragraphs.en: When they flock together, that usually means dead animals.
paragraphs.zh: 当秃鹫成群聚集，通常意味着有动物死亡。

paragraphs.en: He flipped through photos of snares, animal remains, evidence of illegal gold mining.
paragraphs.zh: 他翻阅着一张张照片，里面有捕猎套索、动物残骸、非法淘金留下的痕迹。

paragraphs.en: Here: a fisherman using the wrong kind of net. There: a man with bushmeat in a basket.
paragraphs.zh: 这里：一名渔民使用了违禁渔网。那里：一名男子的篮子里装着野味。

paragraphs.en: Things were calm in block L7 for the time being. Current threats were low-level.
paragraphs.zh: 眼下L7狩猎区块局势平稳。现存威胁都属于低级别。

paragraphs.en: A blessed relief after the best part of a decade spent fighting a crisis during which an estimated 10,000 elephants were killed by poachers linked to criminal gangs.
paragraphs.zh: 过去近十年，保护区一直在应对一场偷猎危机，据估算有一万头大象遭到犯罪团伙勾结的偷猎者猎杀，如今局势缓和，实在令人松了一口气。

paragraphs.en: This was, said Littleton, like fighting a mini war. He barely slept for years.
paragraphs.zh: 利特尔顿称，那段时期就如同打一场小型战争。有好几年他几乎夜夜难眠。

paragraphs.en: The rangers carried a cobbled-together arsenal of AK-47s, shotguns and hunting rifles.
paragraphs.zh: 护林员们的武器五花八门，拼凑而成，包括AK?47突击步枪、霰弹枪以及猎枪。

paragraphs.en: One was shot and injured in a firefight, though he survived.
paragraphs.zh: 曾有一名护林员在交火中中弹受伤，但侥幸活了下来。

paragraphs.en: They don't, he told me, have a policy to shoot poachers on sight; should they catch one, he should be delivered to the police.
paragraphs.zh: 他告诉我，保护区没有一经发现偷猎者便可直接开枪击毙的规定；一旦抓获偷猎者，应当交由警方处理。

paragraphs.en: Or, he clarified, that is "certainly the objective".
paragraphs.zh: 他又补充说明，这“当然是目标”。

paragraphs.en: But there has been one crisis after another.
paragraphs.zh: 然而危机接踵而至。

paragraphs.en: Almost as soon as the poaching crisis was over, there was an Islamist insurgency.
paragraphs.zh: 偷猎危机刚告一段落，伊斯兰武装叛乱便接踵而来。

paragraphs.en: Then, the river burst its banks and carried half the Lugenda camp nearly a mile downstream.
paragraphs.zh: 紧接着，河流决堤，卢根达营地近一半的设施被洪水冲出了将近一英里远。
